name: Michael Hallquist, PhD
bio: Michael integrates personality science, cognitive neuroscience, and computational psychiatry to understand how learning, decision-making, and emotion shape personality and psychopathology. He develops and applies latent variable and reinforcement learning models to link neurocomputational processes with individual differences.

name: Abigale Collins
bio: Abigale studies social and emotional decision-making and the neural mechanisms of psychopathology.
